== The Captain ==
<div class="wv-facts mw-collapsible mw-collapsed"><div class="wv-facts-head mw-collapsible-toggle">Sourced facts <span class="wv-facts-count">3</span></div>
<ul class="wv-fact-list mw-collapsible-content">
<li>{{spoiler|book=lh-01-the-captain|A [[contrasaur]] is a mega-reptile that fed on migratory flocks of extradimensional prey.<ref name="lh-01-the-captain-c32">''The Captain'', chapter 32</ref>}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=lh-01-the-captain|Contrasaur Behemoths are naturally difficult to affect with magic because they swim through [[Aether]].<ref name="lh-01-the-captain-c32" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=lh-01-the-captain|Contrasaur Behemoths can lock down [[Subspace]] for thousands of miles around them.<ref name="lh-01-the-captain-c32" />}}</li>
</ul></div>
